title: arm-none-eabi-gcc toolchain descriptor
description: Compile-only ARM bare-metal toolchain descriptor (32-bit ARM firmwares: Klipper MCU, RepRapFirmware, Marlin STM32). NEVER used for flashing; only --version probe.

source_url.description: Upstream Arm GNU Toolchain. Typically obtained via OS package manager (apt install gcc-arm-none-eabi) or Arm release archive.

install_check.description: Read-only version probe. NEVER a flash command (st-flash, dfu-util, openocd flashing are explicitly excluded).

version_pattern.description: Regex extracting the GCC version triple from --version output.
